The '''Vadooria system''' was located in the<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region's]]<ref name="Slice" /> [[Halla sector/Legends|Halla sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the creatures known as [[Vadoorian sniffer rat]]s.<ref name="Insider134" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vadooria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-9.<ref name="EAOC" />
